name: Sistema modular
prompt: High-fidelity 16:10 desktop homepage for a Brazilian Law course in the same carbon-and-red tensegrity visual world. Almost-white concrete surface, black structural frame and subtle measurement ticks. Top title ESTUDOS DE DIREITO and Curso de Direito. Dominant central Atomium cluster built from exactly four discipline nodes; one selected node expands and reveals only its discipline name and study count. Right side contains four precise directory rows: Introdução ao Estudo do Direito, Ética, Direito Penal, Direito Constitucional I. Bottom technical strip demonstrates graceful topology for 1, 2, 4, 6 and more disciplines and responsive behavior. The visualization follows the discipline list. Premium accessible educational UI, technical condensed labels and calm sans-serif reading type. No subtopics, legal clichés, generic card grid, serif luxury branding, gradients, neon, glassmorphism, photos or people.
